Each component in this kit is meticulously crafted using high-quality wet carbon fibre, ensuring exceptional strength, durability, and a deep gloss finish. Adro's attention to detail and advanced manufacturing process allows every piece to integrate seamlessly with the factory body lines of the G87 M2, enhancing both the vehicle's aesthetics and aerodynamic performance.
